verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a real-time audio/video communications SDK, so a server-side agent participant is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only describes meeting sessions created in web or mobile client applications and PSTN dial-in through SIP media applications. Nothing documents a server-side bot or agent joining as a participant, receiving live audio and publishing synthesized speech back in realtime.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
